title: Icons core
description: minerva-design/icons/core: the icon set without a framework. SVG strings, Canvas2D drawing, GPU canvases, custom icons, the global renderer default and the geometry pipeline behind the GPU backends.

intro.title: Framework-free
intro.text: Importing the core has no side effects and touches no browser API until something is drawn, so it works in server code, workers, any framework and plain scripts. Icons are plain objects: { name, paths, category, tags }.
intro.frameworks: The React, Vue, Angular, Web Components, React Native (minerva-design/native/icons) and Taro (minerva-design/taro/icons) components are thin layers over this core; toSvg and createIconCanvas cover any other framework.

svg-string.title: SVG strings
svg-string.description: toSvg returns a standalone , CSS backgrounds and favicons, and toSvgBase64DataUri a base64 one for image hosts that reject percent-encoded SVG (mini programs).

canvas2d.title: Canvas2D
canvas2d.description: drawIcon strokes an icon on any 2D context (DOM canvas, OffscreenCanvas, mini-program canvases) with native strokes, in the context's transform.

controller.title: Icon canvas controller
controller.description: createIconCanvas, the controller under IconCanvas: appends a canvas to any element, picks the backend, follows the renderer bar, redraws on setItems and frees the GPU context on destroy.

geometry.title: GPU geometry
geometry.description: What the GPU backends draw: tessellateIcon turns the stroke into triangles (quads, round joins and caps), from curves flattened by flattenIconPath within the tolerance. Dots: flattened centerline.

IconDefinition.name: Unique kebab-case name, e.g. arrow-up
IconDefinition.paths: SVG path d strings (M L H V C S Q T A Z, absolute or relative) on the 24×24 grid
IconDefinition.colors: Stroke color of each path, parallel to paths (undefined keeps the drawing color)
IconDefinition.category: Group of the icon, e.g. arrows (built-in icons always have one)

IconSvgOptions.size: Width and height (a number is in pixels)
IconSvgOptions.title: Accessible name: adds role="img" and a <title>; without it the SVG is aria-hidden

DrawIconOptions.x: Left edge in the context's current units
DrawIconOptions.y: Top edge in the context's current units

IconCanvasOptions.items: Icons to draw, in painting order (later ones on top)
IconCanvasOptions.width: Fixed width in CSS pixels; by default the container's width
IconCanvasOptions.height: Fixed height in CSS pixels; by default the container's height
IconCanvasOptions.onRendererChange: Called with the backend once it started, and again after a fallback

IconCanvasController.renderer: The backend drawing (null until it started)
IconCanvasController.setItems: Replaces the icons; drawn on the next animation frame
IconCanvasController.setOptions: Updates options; a new renderer restarts the backend
IconCanvasController.render: Draws now (instead of the next animation frame)
IconCanvasController.ready: Resolves once the backend started and the current items are drawn
IconCanvasController.destroy: Removes the canvas and releases the GPU resources

IconSurfaceOptions.onRendererChange: Called with the backend once it drew, and again after a fallback

IconSurface.renderer: The backend that drew it (null until the first frame)
IconSurface.update: Replaces the options; redrawn on the next animation frame
IconSurface.destroy: Stops drawing (the canvas is left in place)

IconMeshOptions.tolerance: Largest distance between the mesh and the exact outline, in grid units

IconPolyline.closed: Ends with Z (the last point joins the first)
